# Money Plann

> Money Plann is a free AI budget and expense tracker. Talk to your money. The same account works on the web and on the iOS app. There is no subscription.

## Use Money Plann

- [Use the web app](https://moneyplann.com/login): Sign in with email, Google, or Apple, then track expenses, income, and accounts in the browser.
- [Download on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/money-plann/id6777957861): Money Plann for iPhone and iPad. Requires iOS 17 or later. Free, no subscription.

## Product facts

- Name: Money Plann (also called Money Plan)
- Tagline: Talk to your money.
- Category: personal finance, expense tracker, budget
- Price: free
- Web app: https://moneyplann.com/login
- Marketing site: https://moneyplann.com/
- iOS App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/money-plann/id6777957861
- Support: https://moneyplann.com/faq
- Privacy: https://moneyplann.com/privacy
- Contact: support@moneyplann.com

The assistant answers questions about the expenses and income the signed-in user has logged. It does not connect to a bank.
